description: Bind a verified human (a 5arz sessionId or memberId) to a payment you already made, on any rail, and get back a signed credential (atb_jwt) that cross-references the payment and is bound to your agent key. Does not move money. Requires an API key; uses one seal.

agentKeyThumbprint.description: RFC 7638 thumbprint of your agent key; the credential binds to it (cnf.jkt).

apiKey.description: Optional: pass your key here if your client cannot set the Authorization header.

memberId.description: A 5arz identity-verified member, instead of sessionId.

orderId.description: A 5arz order id, instead of paymentRef.

paymentRef.description: Your payment's transaction id or reference. paymentRef or orderId is required.

workRef.description: Optional work reference when using memberId.

name: bind_human_to_payment
title: Bind a verified human to a payment you made
